component.name: AI Agent Control Center
component.summary: Govern, route, and audit bounded local AI agents

description.p: AI Agent Control Center is a local desktop governance layer for a persistent AI workforce. It creates, configures, monitors, routes, executes, reviews, and audits bounded agents while the human owner stays authoritative over permissions, approvals, external actions, and release decisions.

The Tauri and Rust backend owns durable state, capability policy, approval authority, and single-run coordination. Agents run only through the installed Codex CLI or a local Ollama instance, and the offline voice runtime, KDE portal integration, reminders, and structured memory all operate under the same backend policy boundary.
